charts.name: Reloads per getTimeline call

settings.label: shown_below

charts.explanation: Average number of reload requests per getTimeline call. Higher means more wasted reloads per complication update.

chart_queries.sql_query: SELECT if(get_timeline_count > 0, reload_count / get_timeline_count , 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT sumMerge(complication_reload_requested_count_sum) AS reload_count, sumMerge(complication_get_timeline_called_count_sum) AS get_timeline_count FROM {{source}} WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}} )

charts.name: Valid Latency (s)

settings.label: shown_below
settings.description: Time between last reload request and getTimeline call, for valid measurements only (non-restart, within 600s window). Shows p50, p90, p95, p99, and max.

charts.explanation: Time between last reload request and getTimeline call, for valid measurements only (non-restart, within 600s window). Shows p50, p90, p95, p99, and max.

chart_queries.sql_query:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(dt, INTERVAL 60 MINUTE) AS time,
    countMerge(latency_seconds_valid_count) AS n,
    maxMerge(latency_seconds_valid_max) AS "max",
    quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)(latency_seconds_valid_quantiles)[1] AS "p50",
    quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)(latency_seconds_valid_quantiles)[2] AS "p90",
    quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)(latency_seconds_valid_quantiles)[3] AS "p95",
    quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)(latency_seconds_valid_quantiles)[4] AS "p99"
  FROM {{source}}
  WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT time, p50, p90, p95, p99, max
FROM buckets
WHERE n >= 2
ORDER BY time

charts.name: 60s < Latency < 300s

settings.label: shown_below
settings.description: Percentage and count of getTimeline calls where latency was between 60 and 300 seconds.

charts.explanation: Percentage and count of getTimeline calls where latency was between 60 and 300 seconds.

chart_queries.sql_query:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    sumMerge(complication_latency_60_300_sum) AS between_60_300,
    sumMerge(complication_latency_gt300_sum)  AS over_300,
    sumMerge(complication_get_timeline_called_count_sum) AS calls
  FROM {{source}}
  WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}
)
SELECT
  calls,
  between_60_300,
  over_300,
  (between_60_300 + over_300) AS events,
  if(calls > 0, round((between_60_300 + over_300) * 100.0 / calls, 2), 0) AS rate
FROM totals

charts.name: Dashboard Notes

settings.label: shown_below
settings.static_text:
**Interpretation notes**

• Association % and Delta Distribution % are unreliable when total calls per bucket is very low (N ≤ 2). Cross-reference with Reload-Association bar heights.
• Delta Distribution % uses 60m buckets to reduce noise from sparse data.
• SLO panels (≤ 60s, ≤ 300s) use pre-existing latency bucket metrics and do NOT filter for provider_restart or latency_valid — they measure all getTimeline calls.
• App Group canary should always be 0. Any non-zero value explains downstream metric anomalies.
• Provider Restart Rate % denominator = complication events only (restart + non-restart), not all log events.
• Latency Validity Rate % = valid_latency_events / non-restart complication calls.
• Phase 0.2 extraction rules were created on 2026-03-06 and are not retroactive. Data before that date uses only the older complication_latency_* bucket metrics.

chart_queries.static_text:
# **Interpretation notes**

- **Generation Delta Distribution** uses 1h buckets. **Δ=0 == system-driven** (no preceding reload). **Δ=1 == 1:1** reload match. **Δ>1** means WatchOS coalesced multiple reloads.
- **Valid Latency** panels are validity-gated (non-restart + within 600s). SLO panels (≤ 60s, ≤ 300s) use latency bucket metrics across ALL getTimeline calls (not filtered by restart or validity).
- **Valid Latency** chart only includes calls where latency was measurable: non-restart and within the 600s validity window.
- **App Group** canary should **always be 0**. Non-zero means the extension can't read shared data from the watch app.
- **Latency Validity Rate** = valid latency events / non-restart complication calls.

charts.name: Reload-associated getTimeline
charts.explanation: are timelines being driven by our reloads vs the system?

chart_queries.sql_query: SELECT IF(coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq0_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq1_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_2_5_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_gt5_sum),0) > 0, (coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq1_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_2_5_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_gt5_sum),0)) * 100.0 / (coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq0_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq1_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_2_5_sum),0)+coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_gt5_sum),0)), NULL) AS "Reload-associated %" FROM {{source}} WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}

charts.name: Latency Validity Rate

settings.label: shown_below
settings.description: Percentage of non-restart getTimeline calls that produced a valid latency measurement. 100% means every eligible call had a usable timestamp.

charts.explanation: Percentage of non-restart getTimeline calls that produced a valid latency measurement. 100% means every eligible call had a usable timestamp.

charts.name: Latency SLO (≤ 60s)

settings.label: shown_below
settings.description: Percentage of all getTimeline calls with latency at or below 60 seconds. Uses pre-existing latency bucket metrics across all calls (not filtered by restart or validity).

charts.explanation: Percentage of all getTimeline calls with latency ≤60 seconds. Uses pre-existing latency bucket metrics (not filtered by restart or validity).

chart_queries.sql_query:
SELECT
  IF(
    coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_le2_sum), 0)
    + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_2_10_sum), 0)
    + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_10_60_sum), 0)
    + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_60_300_sum), 0)
    + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_gt300_sum), 0) > 0,
    (coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_le2_sum), 0)
     + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_2_10_sum), 0)
     + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_10_60_sum), 0)) * 100.0
    / (coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_le2_sum), 0)
       + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_2_10_sum), 0)
       + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_10_60_sum), 0)
       + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_60_300_sum), 0)
       + coalesce(sumMerge(complication_latency_gt300_sum), 0)),
    NULL
  ) AS "SLO rate %"
FROM {{source}}
WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}

charts.name: Complication Reload Latency
charts.explanation: Overall distribution of getTimeline latency across all bucket ranges for the selected time window.

chart_queries.sql_query:
WITH
  arrayJoin([
    ('Latency <= 2s', sumMerge(complication_latency_le2_sum)),
    ('2s < Latency < 10s', sumMerge(complication_latency_2_10_sum)),
    ('10s < Latency < 60s', sumMerge(complication_latency_10_60_sum)),
    ('60s < Latency < 300s', sumMerge(complication_latency_60_300_sum)),
    ('Latency > 300', sumMerge(complication_latency_gt300_sum))
  ]) AS arrayJoinValues
SELECT
  arrayJoinValues.1 AS bucket,
  arrayJoinValues.2 AS value
FROM {{source}}
WHERE
  dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}

charts.name: Generation Delta Distribution

settings.label: shown_below
settings.description: How many complication getTimeline calls fell into each generation-delta bucket per hour. Δ=0 means WatchOS called without a preceding reload. Δ=1 means 1:1 match. Δ>1 means coalesced reloads.

charts.explanation: How many getTimeline calls fell into each generation-delta bucket per hour. Δ=0: system-driven (no preceding reload). Δ=1: 1:1 reload match. Δ>1: WatchOS coalesced multiple reloads.

chart_queries.sql_query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(dt, INTERVAL 60 MINUTE) AS time,
  coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq0_sum), 0) AS "System-driven (Δ=0)",
  coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_eq1_sum), 0) AS "Reload 1:1 (Δ=1)",
  coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_2_5_sum), 0) AS "Coalesced (Δ 2-5)",
  coalesce(sumMerge(generation_delta_gt5_sum), 0) AS "Heavily coalesced (Δ>5)"
FROM {{source}}
WHERE dt BETWEEN {{start_time}} AND {{end_time}}
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
